text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Focus... Focus... Drawing focus lines... 
toward the race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta do my best in the Mile 
Championship. It's the grand culmination 
of Digi-tan's Classic Class!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race. Uncharacteristically, 
Agnes Digital paid no attention to the 
other Umamusume at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today's rival. About King Halo, whom she 
admired and worried about so much.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's head to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that paddockâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Who's today's star?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, me! I am the one who—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SHING!*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kiiing Halo! O-ho-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo was there, striking a dramatic 
pose with pure delight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(King-san...! This aura, her silky-smooth 
legs, and... this overflowing vitality!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I believed in you... Yes, of course I 
believed...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seemed she felt there was no need to 
worry.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Digital-san, how do I look to you today?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Was that blinding brilliance too much for 
your eyes to take in?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a textbook upward climb! That 
out-of-sync feeling across my whole body 
back in summer is nowhere to be found!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However, the sleekness along her back 
doesn't quite match where she was in the 
spring...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"My, there's no fooling you, is there? To 
think you'd notice all that..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just how much do you like me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Deeper than the Mariana Trench, of course! 
We've gotten closer lately, so my devotion 
just keeps growing and growing~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We shared a laugh. Even if she wasn't 
completely back in top form, it was clear 
King Halo was beginning to break out of 
her slump.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King-san, thank you for having me today! 
Digitan is... Digitan is...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to know what lies deep down at the 
very core of your heart in today's race!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, without you even having to ask, I'll 
make them learn their lesson.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Brace your entire body and soul to take in 
what it truly means to be first-rate, 
Digital-san!
